description: Check a nonce, and with clicks the click task too, against a challenge from create_captcha, once: the call uses the challenge up, right or wrong, so it cannot be used to test guesses. Answers valid true, or valid false with reason wrong_nonce, wrong_clicks, expired, used or unknown, and the level of the challenge (null when used or unknown): compare it with the level the form asks for, since the browser fetched the challenge. No API key, no account and no sign up.

clicks.description: Optional: the points clicked in the picture, three to five as the question asks, in its order, as x-y in picture pixels joined by _.

nonce.description: The nonce found, in decimal without leading zeros, at most 9007199254740991.

name: verify_captcha
title: Verify a captcha nonce
